build: Modwerk's linker: Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant 1c14b6b0) + this folder's Improved FLTR 0.1.0-experimental (built by scripts/build-elemod-packages.mjs), materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version IFS2

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: revision 2ac0f1f (the author's local build with a RAM-boot patch, as Improved AMP's captures); no card (starts formatted); JIT on; --every 1000M; DTBOOT_TURN_PNG=a after each turn

conditions: Cold boot; eight NO presses from 7003M, 300M apart, close the calibration notices. FILTER at 11003M; 27 turns of TYP (encoder 6) by +6 from 11303M, 20M apart (LP2 to BW: the seventh step); 45 turns of FRQ (encoder 4) by -6 from 12003M (FRQ 47, about 208 Hz); 40 turns of RES (encoder 5) by +6 from 13003M. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified. Without Filter Hz in the build FRQ shows stock's number.
